definitions.explanation: A financial situation where income exceeds expenses or gains exceed losses.

examples.japanese: {今期|こんき}は{黒字|くろじ}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: We achieved a profit this term.

examples.japanese: ようやく{黒字|くろじ}に{転|てん}じた。
examples.english: We finally turned a profit / moved into the black.

examples.japanese: {貿易|ぼうえき}{黒字|くろじ}が{増|ふ}えている。

notes:
{黒字|くろじ} literally means 'black letters', from the practice of recording profits in black ink.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒字|くろじ}になる (to become profitable)
- {黒字|くろじ}を{出|だ}す (to make a profit)
- {黒字|くろじ}に{転|てん}じる (to turn a profit)
- {黒字|くろじ}{経営|けいえい} (profitable operations)
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{黒字|くろじ} (trade surplus)

CONTRAST:
- {黒字|くろじ} (surplus, in the black)
- {赤字|あかじ} (deficit, in the red)

NOTE:
{黒字|くろじ}{倒産|とうさん} (bankruptcy despite profitability) refers to companies that go bankrupt due to cash flow problems despite being profitable on paper.
